items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1954-06
items.q: Even to Peter, he was wrapped with Christ at his, at times his faith is weak.

ctx.x: Well, hey, don't you think that they would have believed if they would have read? Instead of taking the words of the priests and the elders and the scribes and the Pharisees, if individuals then, uh, we know that the, ratio of education was about 1,000% lower than ours in those days. Don't you think that the, the Jews as a nation would have known Jesus and would have recognized him as their savior and as the heavenly king if they would have read themselves? Uh, most people go to church today. They just take the…

Well, that's true. And, um, people are just like, uh, the people those days are just like they were, just like they are now. They, uh, they, they, a lot of people read, but yet they don't understand what they read. And a lot of people read and, and they don't believe what they read. And, uh, wait now, because I think you are the very person. You're absolutely right. You talk in all your Bible quotations and what people should believe in. And you read this moment. Your faith is, is, is, is less than a size of a…

It isn't the point of doubting God. It's the point of doubting oneself. Well, one doesn't doubt God because, Oh, then you are doubting yourself. That's right. God is sure and his promises are sure. But man. But why you can't believe that his promises are sure? His promises are sure. Why? Why you don't believe?
